name: Minute Marriage
source:
Dear Season 24 Contestant, we're so excited for you to meet your match. As usual, you have only one minute to decide whether or not to tie the knot. It's like speed dating with 100% more commitment! Learn all you can about them and make your informed decision. 

Minute Marriage & Associates, Inc. are not legally responsible for what happens after you tie the knot OR reject your match.

May the wedding bells ring...

[From [url=https://emcatgames.itch.io/minute-marriage]Itch.io[/url]]
